name: ShipsEar
description: ShipsEar underwater ship noise, 90 recordings and 11 classes. Accuracy under a propagation shift. Santos-Domínguez et al., Applied Acoustics 2016. DeepShip, about 47 hours and four classes, is a companion note in this record. Audio not vendored.
